Abstract
This experiment examines laser exposure condition after stress-relief annealing of LPBF Ti-6Al-4V.

Materials and Methods
Ti-6Al-4V coupons were fabricated by LPBF and stress-relief annealed at 800 C before X-ray computed tomography.

Results
For the stress-relieved sample state after annealing at 800 C, changing laser exposure condition from low exposure to high exposure decreased porosity from 1.5% to 0.6% in Ti-6Al-4V measured by X-ray computed tomography.

Conclusions
The post-processed specimens require a separate comparison stratum from as-built material.
